The '''elephant slug''' was a creature seen on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. Orange in color, with a long snout and green eyes, the slug could roll into a ball to attack its enemies.

==Behind the scenes==
The creature was first seen in 1991's [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (1991 video game)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' video game]], and named in the game's manual.
